name: OmaMessenger
author: OmaMessenger contributors
description: A keyboard-first unified messaging client for Omarchy.

barWidget.description: Unread WhatsApp and Telegram messages, with a click to open the conversation window.

schema.label: Notifications
schema.description: Show a desktop notification for new messages.

schema.label: Reopen after restart
schema.description: If OmaMessenger's window was open when Omarchy's shell restarted or reloaded, open it again once the plugin starts back up.

schema.label: Notification detail
schema.description: How much a notification reveals: the sender and message text, just who it is from, or a generic notice with neither. Omarchy keeps a copy of every notification in its history, readable by other programs, so names and text are off by default.

schema.label: Default notification sound
schema.description: A sound file (WAV, Ogg or MP3) to play for an arriving message, when neither the service below nor the conversation itself (the command palette's "Set notification sound…") has its own. Blank or "default" plays nothing, matching OmaMessenger's own long-standing silence; "none" also plays nothing, but stops a per-service sound below from being asked for either. Omarchy's own notification popups never play a sound themselves, so this is the only way to get one. The file is validated before it is ever played; one that fails is treated as no sound rather than shown as an error here.

schema.label: WhatsApp notification sound
schema.description: Overrides the default notification sound above for every WhatsApp conversation that has not set its own. Blank or "default" inherits the setting above; "none" silences WhatsApp specifically, even when the default above has a sound.

schema.label: Telegram notification sound
schema.description: The same as the WhatsApp setting above, for Telegram.

schema.label: Read receipts
schema.description: Off means incognito mode: OmaMessenger never tells a service a chat here was read, so the phone and any other device signed into the same account keep showing it unread. Also reachable from the command palette's "Toggle read receipts".

schema.label: Spell check
schema.description: Underline misspelled words in English while composing a message.

schema.label: Spelling dictionary
schema.description: Which English spelling to check against. Automatic follows this computer's own locale.
